fields.help: Check the box to enter spatially varying values (i.e., one value per parcel) for fraction of precipitation that contributes to overland runoff. You will enter this information later.

Enter the fraction of precipitation that contributes to overland runoff for all areas in the modeling. The default value of 0.40 is provide reference source. Note that this fraction, the evapotranspiration fraction, and the groundwater seepage fraction must total 1.0.
